QuestInfo.name: Rebuilding
QuestInfo.0: So this is Maple World, but not the one you know. Hundreds of years have passed since... Well, at least the other heroes are alive. Find Freud and talk to him. Athena Pierce will know where he is, hopefully.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce says Ossyria isn't what it used to be, and suggested you stay on Victoria Island until you get a bit stronger. She says she will let you know if she hears from any of the other heroes.
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to build your power on Victoria Island first. Athena would like you to help others out while trying to get a better feel of Maple World. Go to Ellinel Fairy Academy.

0.msg: But I need to see Freud. Is he still studying the dragons in Leafre? I should head there now.

1.msg: Freud is... Look, Ossyria is not as you remember it. The monsters there would tear you apart. They probably don't even look as they once did.

2.msg: You should stay and train your skills. I'll let you know if I hear from any of the heroes.

yes.0: You've made the right decision. Please wait for me to contact you.

no.0: There's no need to rush. I know this is difficult to take in, but what you need is more time to get yourself together.
